purpose: Teach: 菅野/岩国/西宮/さいたま/前川/河村/鎌田/北川

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 菅野部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's start preparing for the welcome reception for Manager Sugano.
lines.style: Efficient, organized. Sharp attack on the first word. Steady pace, matter-of-fact tone. Speaking as someone who has done this before and knows what needs doing. No breath for hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。岩国工場の月次報告を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the Iwakuni factory's monthly report.
lines.style: Attentive, ready to move. Slight nod in the voice at the opening. Clear, methodical. Reassuring in its straightforwardness — showing he's already thinking ahead to what comes next.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 西宮支店のキャンペーンを企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's draft the campaign strategy for the Nishi-Nomiya branch.
lines.style: Purposeful forward momentum. Clean onset. Mid-range tone, collaborative but directing. Slight upward inflection suggesting her confidence in the plan. Encourages motion forward without rushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。さいたま事業所の研修プランを整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll get the training plan ready for the Saitama office.
lines.style: Dependable and present. Calm delivery. Medium tempo, no flourish. The tone of someone checking boxes without resentment — genuinely engaged in the work at hand.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 前川主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the project progress update from Team Lead Maekawa.
lines.style: Clear directive with quiet authority. Definite attack. Steady, even pacing. The tone of someone coordinating moving parts — not bossy, but someone who expects things to land cleanly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。河村経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask the Legal department to review the new contract.
lines.style: Measured and composed. Even tone. Medium pace, professional without stiffness. The last line — deliver it with a sense of closing out one task to move toward the next.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 鎌田技術主任の設計レビューを進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the design review with Technical Lead Kamata.
lines.style: Steady, action-oriented. Soft but firm onset. Moderate pace, flowing naturally. The voice of someone who has the details in hand and is ready to keep things moving.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。北川法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll contact Legal to review the new contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, assured tone. Slightly slower finish — the feeling of wrapping up and making sure everything lands in the right hands. Thoughtful closure.
